scope: BF16 reference review only; all six base cases inspected. EXL3 comparison and isolated timing benchmarks remain pending.

photo.criterion: A coherent red toy sailboat, white sail and blue fabric; no new severe structural defects relative to BF16.
photo.observation: 2048x2048 completed. Red wooden toy sailboat, white triangular sail and blue fabric visible. Small tile-boundary marks are present in this BF16 reference.

text.criterion: Compare HELLO legibility, unintended text and poster layout against BF16.
text.observation: HELLO is readable, dark blue on cream with yellow stars; no extra text.

composition.criterion: Compare object counts, colors and left/right arrangement against BF16.
composition.observation: Red sphere left, blue cube right, yellow pyramid between them.

rgba.criterion: Nontrivial alpha channel, visible fox, usable cutout edges; compare subject and transparency with BF16.
rgba.observation: Origami fox visible; alpha 0..255, approximately 68% of pixels <=5/255. Composited image and alpha map inspected; transparent RGB payload is not a visible background.

edit.criterion: Requested hull color changes while boat identity, sail and scene are preserved relative to BF16.
edit.observation: Hull is green; white sail, wooden mast and blue fabric/camera composition are preserved.

multi_ref.criterion: The scene combines recognizable content from both references, compared with BF16.
multi_ref.observation: Red sailboat, red sphere and blue cube from both references are recognizable in one scene; the yellow pyramid is also retained.
